tweet_text: Most people think AI replaces the work. It does not. It collapses the time. Here is the actual stack one person can run today (1/5)
card_hook: AI does not replace work. It collapses time.
card_body: Five tools. One operator. Full agency output.
thread_followups: (2/5) Claude Code: writes code, drafts copy, reviews PRs, runs research subagents in parallel. The brain.
(3/5) n8n: routes everything. Webhooks, cron, OAuth, AI calls, Sheets, ManyChat. The nervous system.
(4/5) Vercel: ships static, edge, serverless, preview deploys per branch. The hands.
(5/5) Supabase + GHL: data + CRM + scheduler. The memory. That is the full stack. Five tools. One operator. Replace this with people only when revenue forces you.

tweet_text: Pricing AEO at $5K/mo and clients still say yes. Here is why the LLM-citation lane is the cleanest mid-tier opening in agency since 2014 (1/4)
card_body: The cleanest mid-tier agency lane since 2014.
thread_followups: (2/4) SEO mid-tier is dead. $1.5K/mo gets you 50 SEO agencies fighting for the same Google ranking. Race to zero.
(3/4) AEO is the same buyer, same budget, no competition. Get cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini. Measurable. Provable.
(4/4) The agencies that learn LLM citations now own the next 18 months. After that the lane fills like SEO did. Window is open. Walk through it.

tweet_text: I run a one-person agency. 9 client demos shipped in 6 weeks. Here is the system that makes it possible without burnout (1/4)
card_hook: One person. Nine demos. Six weeks.
thread_followups: (2/4) Skill files. Every workflow lives in /.claude/skills/ as a runbook. Trigger word loads it. Same quality every time. No memory required.
(3/4) Templates over starters. 20-niche demo repo. Fork, retheme, deploy in 90 minutes. Speculative pitch goes out same day.
(4/4) Parallel agents. Research, draft, build, review run at the same time, not sequential. One operator becomes a four-person team in clock-time.

tweet_text: The 4 mistakes that kept me at $2K/month for two years. Fixed them in one quarter. Hit $20K/month the next. Here they are (1/5)
card_body: Fixed in one quarter. Receipts in thread.
thread_followups: (2/5) Mistake 1: pricing by hour. Switched to fixed-scope. Margin tripled because clients paid for outcome, not effort.
(3/5) Mistake 2: hiding the demo behind a discovery call. Started shipping demos in the proposal. Close rate doubled.
(4/5) Mistake 3: writing every post from scratch. Built a hook bank + template stack. Shipped 5x more without burning out.
(5/5) Mistake 4: chasing every niche. Picked 3 verticals where I had real proof. Inbound got better, churn dropped, referrals tripled.
